turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to start exercising again and I'm stuck between a few options.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold your thoughts until I've described all the options.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first one is joining the gym near my office, it's pricey but I'd go right after work.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's running outside, totally free, but I tend to skip it when the weather's bad.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is a home workout app with short twenty minute sessions I can do in the living room.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alright, I'm finished. What's your opinion?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The gym near your office has a big advantage, going right after work makes it easy to build a habit. Running is free, but if bad weather stops you, it might not stick. The home app is the most flexible, and twenty minutes is easy to fit in.
